name: Mento Euro
oneLiner: EURm is Mento's oracle-priced euro stablecoin on Celo, mint and redeem through the Mento reserve backed by a diversified crypto and stablecoin basket.
collateral: Mento Reserve holding sUSDS, AUSD, CELO, USDC, EURC, USDT, axlEUROC, and stETH; overcollateralized with a stable-asset backing mandate.
pegMechanism: Mento V3 reserve-backed FX model: EURm is minted and redeemed against the shared Mento Reserve through Fixed-Price Market Maker (FPMM) pools that quote a Chainlink EUR oracle rate rather than deriving price from pool reserves, with on-chain trading limits and circuit breakers halting trade when the oracle is stale or off-peg.

oracleRisk.summary: Mento V3 routes EURm pricing through Chainlink-backed SortedOracles and OracleAdapter, while BreakerBox rejects stale, out-of-bounds, or off-peg feeds before FPMM swaps use them.

mintAuthority.summary: EURm minting on Celo routes through the Mento Broker contract (confirmed isMinter), while token ownership resolves to a 4/6 Mento Safe; identical structure to verified GBPm.

controls.label: Mento Broker — authorized minter for EURm
controls.capDescription: Mento Broker minting is rate-limited by Mento exchange limits and circuit breakers on the EURm FPMM pool.
controls.evidence: At Celo block 69291541, isMinter(0x777A8255cA72412f0d706dc03C9D1987306B4CaD) returned true. Minting is rate-limited by Mento exchange limits and circuit breakers on the FPMM pool.
